text: Emergency spare parts are automatically reserved by the system.
Autonomous Personhood Verification
Create, educate, and formally register genuinely independent new persons.
Synthetic people need housing, work, and daily services.
Draw a clear line between tools and equipment and “people,” defining their rights and responsibilities, residency, property, and political representation.
Ordinary equipment continues to be maintained automatically, but each new person still requires individual approval.
Synthetic Community
Admit synthetic people as public representatives and assign them institutional responsibilities.
A community can be governed jointly by mixed residents or by a synthetic majority.
Registered persons must never be bought or sold as equipment; safety audits and isolation must include a means of appeal.
Coordinate daily shifts, body maintenance, and public duties collectively.
Controlled Fusion and Thermal Management
Build high-load fusion power plants and supporting heat-dissipation systems.
Energy-intensive bodies and manufacturing no longer need to burn wood constantly.
Fuel assemblies, cooling, and routine maintenance still require proper expenditure; reserve enough emergency power to maintain a baseline during shutdowns.
Grid power is automatically allocated by priority, with basic needs first.
Battlefield Echo Investigation
Identify residual signals from neural links left on old battlefields.
Only incomplete information can be received; no abilities or supplies can be gained from nothing.
Seal it on site, study it cautiously, or risk neural damage by forcing a connection?
Archive and follow up on records of on-site exposure through an independent monitoring agency.
Shared Housing
Adds 240 beds; residents still require daily provisions and housing maintenance.
Clinical and Research Building
Equipped with 12 research workstations; spends medicine, knowledge, and power each period.
Precision Manufacturing Workshop
Each workshop has 16 workstations and uses available raw materials to manufacture cultures, electrothermal alloys, mechanical bodies, and fuel assemblies.
Circular Farm
Each farm has 16 workstations; produces grain from improved soil, with daily maintenance and water supplies required.
Wind and Solar Storage Array
Each array produces 100–180 power depending on the season and provides up to 400 storage; it requires regular maintenance and is not an unlimited source of power.
Follow-up and Ecology Station
Equipped with 8 workstations for long-term clinical follow-up and ecological monitoring; also treats ordinary residents.
Body Repair and Appeals Center
Equipped with 8 workstations to maintain complete mechanical bodies, review fault-related isolation, and ensure continuity of the same person.
Fusion Plant and Cooling Towers
Equipped with 12 workstations; consumes 2 fuel assemblies and 2 parts each period, producing 900 power; maximum heat dissipation capacity is 1200.
Community Assembly Hall
Equipped with 6 administrative workstations; sets community policy on bodily rights, daily provisions, and responsibilities for supplying surplus public materials.
